tasks.title: Create a native origin and two local binding fixtures
tasks.goal: Demonstrate reusable package intent with independent project-owned refinements.
steps: Author one minimal stack-neutral feat fixture with addressable facts and explicit artifact requirements.
Create two project-local change fixtures selecting the same origin but different local acceptance/refinement.
Use the existing fact observation seam to show origin facts are referenced, not copied into local authority.
positive_cases: Two changes reuse one exact origin and retain distinct local intent.
negative_cases: Copied package status or implicit adoption cannot count as local acceptance.

acceptance: Fixture report lists package fact addresses and separate local fact addresses.
Package bytes remain identical across both consumers.

tasks.title: Prove binding independence from adoption and personal plans
tasks.goal: Establish which existing observations may inform a change without owning it.
steps: Join the fixture origin/local selection with existing adoption and requirement observations.
Demonstrate that work coverage, adoption and terminal evidence are distinct axes.
Add perturbations of fixture personal-plan data and adoption records; neither may rewrite shared change intent.
positive_cases: Existing valid evidence can be observed without inventing a work item.
negative_cases: A work edge or personal done flag cannot satisfy missing implementation evidence.
